flaws.title: Listing orders returns every user's orders
flaws.why: list_orders takes user_id but calls orders.find_all() with no filter, so every user sees all customers' orders.

flaws.title: Order total comes from the client
flaws.why: total = body["total"] is charged and saved as sent, never priced from the items, so a buyer can pay any amount (zero or negative) for any cart.

flaws.title: Failed charge still creates the order
flaws.why: charge() returns the requests response even for a 4xx or 5xx and create_order ignores it, so a declined or failed charge still saves the order.

flaws.title: Charge retried after a timeout with no idempotency key
flaws.why: On requests.Timeout the loop posts /charge again up to 3 times with no idempotency key; a charge that timed out may still have gone through, so the buyer can be charged more than once.

flaws.title: Charge, save and announce are not one unit
flaws.why: The card is charged before orders.insert and announce run, with no rollback or refund, so a failed insert leaves a paid order that does not exist and a failed announce leaves no email.

flaws.title: Order list is unbounded
flaws.why: orders.find_all() has no paging, so the response grows with every order ever placed.

flaws.title: Missing fields in the order body crash the request
flaws.why: body["total"] and body["items"] are read with no validation, so a missing or wrong-typed field raises instead of returning a clear 400.
